fullPassage: Plato's realism includes all aspects of experience but is most easily explained by considering the nature of mathematical and geometrical objects such as circles. He asked the question, what is a circle? You might indicate a particular example carved into stone or drawn in the sand. However, Plato would point out that, if you looked closely enough, you would see that neither it, nor indeed any physical circle, was perfect. They all possessed flaws, and all were subject to change and decayed with time. So how can we talk about perfect circles if we cannot actually see or touch them? Plato's extraordinary answer was that the world we see is a poor reflection of a deeper unseen reality of Forms, or universals, where perfect cats chase perfect mice in perfect circles around perfect rocks. Plato believed that the Forms or universals are the true reality that exists in an invisible but perfect world beyond our senses.

② considering: 수학적·기하학적 대상의 본질을 '고려함'으로써 가장 쉽게 설명됨 ←정답
③ forgetting(잊다): 문맥과 반대
④ doubting(의심하다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: by considering ~ = ~을 고려함으로써

questions.passage: Plato's realism includes all aspects of experience but is most easily explained by considering the nature of mathematical and geometrical objects such as circles. He asked the question, what is a circle? You might indicate a particular example carved into stone or drawn in the sand. However, Plato would point out that, if you looked closely enough, you would see that neither it, nor indeed any physical circle, was perfect. They all possessed flaws, and all were __________ and decayed with time. So how can we talk about perfect circles if we cannot actually see or touch them? Plato's extraordinary answer was that the world we see is a poor reflection of a deeper unseen reality of Forms, or universals, where perfect cats chase perfect mice in perfect circles around perfect rocks. Plato believed that the Forms or universals are the true reality that exists in an invisible but perfect world beyond our senses.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① immune to change(변화에 영향받지 않는): 부패한다는 뒤 내용과 모순
② free from harm(해로부터 자유로운): 결함을 지녔다는 앞 내용과 모순
③ safe from decay(부패로부터 안전한): 바로 뒤 decayed와 모순
④ subject to change: 결함을 지녀 '변하기 쉽고' 시간이 지나며 부패함 ←정답
det.tip: be subject to ~ = ~하기 쉽다. subject to change = 변하기 쉬운
